# Package that names `entityId`

A synthetic package in the shape releases v0.38.0 to v0.41.0 wrote. Its
generated model and inventories name the Record type of a route, access entry, query operation and
source relation `entityId`, where this release writes `recordType`. The files
are kept byte for byte so the refusal of that shape is tested against a fixed
package. Its stored source also writes `accessProfiles` as a list.
